parameters.query: WITH prepared AS (SELECT d.* FROM public.create_delivery_attempt($1::bigint,$6,'offer:'||$1::text||':'||$6,$8,$2) d WHERE $5::bigint IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.*,TRUE AS should_send FROM public.lead_routing_delivery_attempts a JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o ON o.current_delivery_attempt_id=a.attempt_id JOIN public.agents g ON g.agent_id=a.target_agent_id AND g.is_available=true AND g.whatsapp_number=a.target_number WHERE $5::bigint IS NOT NULL AND a.attempt_id=$5::bigint AND a.opportunity_id=$1::bigint AND a.routing_tier=$6 AND a.status='requested' AND a.provider_message_id IS NULL AND a.lease_token=$7 AND a.lease_expires_at>NOW()) SELECT prepared.*,target_number AS number,$3 AS text,$4 AS button_id FROM prepared;
